skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the general principles of international business law, including the subjects, sources, principles, and institutions involved in international business activities.

Understand and analyze the general principles and specific regulations of international business contracts, including international sales contracts, international service contracts, and international investment contracts.
Understand and analyze the general principles and specific regulations of dispute resolution in international business activities.
Develop skills in approaching, researching, identifying, and resolving legal issues arising from international business relations.

Develop skills in negotiating, drafting documents, and participating in international business relations, especially in international trade contracts, international service contracts, and international investment contracts.
Develop skills in listening, presenting, and working in groups.
Develop the ability to independently research, study, accumulate, and enhance professional knowledge and skills.
Develop the ability to plan and execute tasks, coordinate and leverage collective intelligence, and propose innovative solutions during task execution.
Understand, analyze, and apply professional ethics.
